Class MoleculePackSettings

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.molecule.MoleculePackSettings
public final class MoleculePackSettings extends Object
Applies shared display settings to matching molecules. Files run in the caller's explicit order; each file applies its defaults, then its rules in array order. A later assignment replaces an earlier value for that setting only. Source definitions and previously published views are never modified.

    • apply

      public static MoleculeResources.Data apply(MoleculeResources.Data data, List<MoleculePackSettings.Layer> layers)
      Writes effective display values into the synchronized JSON. Geometry, associations and tags remain intact. Definition-local values are the baseline; ordered pack/instance/world rules override them.
      Parameters:
      data - merged definitions before policy evaluation
      layers - settings in increasing precedence
      Returns:
      new resource data, or the original data when no settings files exist
